options: Use major ideas independently in a new situation and explain the reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Explore types of work
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on types of work. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where dignity of labour is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach interdependence to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
